source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Create: Adding New Records as printed (PDF 59, printed 55); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 4.2 lesson.

blocks.text: The Create operation is used to add new data to a database table. It stores information such as names, values, or records. SQL insert commands are used for this purpose. Python sends these commands to the database. New records become part of the stored data after execution.
